newsitem.title: LEBANON: Bank of Lebanon issues CDs worth 83 bln pounds.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Lebanon issues CDs worth 83 bln pounds.

text.p: The Bank of Lebanon issued on Thursday certificates of deposit dated February 28 to commercial banks worth 83 billion Lebanese pounds.
The bank sold 60-day certificates worth 70 billion pounds at 13 percent annual interest and 45-day CDs worth 13 billion pounds at 12.25 percent.
Last week the Bank sold 60-day CDs worth 68 billion pounds at 13 percent and 45-day CDs worth nine billion pounds at 12.25 percent.
